approvedDeviationsHonoured: AC2 — the ≤80-character length condition is removed entirely (operator 2026-07-30). Measured on 286 real paragraph blocks: zero whole-bold non-headings exist, so length discriminated nothing and only clipped genuine headings.

selectorCensus.why: pytest -k matching nothing exits 0, so an unwritten test is indistinguishable from a passing one. Counts collected are reported, never exit codes. -k is case-insensitive but underscore-sensitive — that is exactly how heading_heuristic missed TestHeadingHeuristic.

findings.title: The 'heuristic OFF for orangetrack' half of TS-9 is pinned by no test — flipping it fails nothing
findings.expected: tech-spec § Testing Strategy: 'Heuristic off for orangetrack, on for the others — asserted per source.' Switching orangetrack's headings_from_bold to True should turn a test red.
findings.actual: Measured, not derived: across all 24 golden fixtures orangetrack has 26 paragraph blocks and ZERO of them satisfy dom_blocks.looks_like_heading, so enabling the heuristic for orangetrack changes no fixture and therefore fails no test — including the golden gate, which is otherwise this feature's hard gate. The ON half is properly pinned for t-hunted.
findings.reproduction: python3 -c "import json, dom_blocks; g=json.load(open('tests/fixtures/orangetrack_golden.json')); print(sum(1 for e in g['fixtures'].values() for b in ((e.get('parsed') or {}).get('blocks') or []) if b.get('type')=='paragraph' and dom_blocks.looks_like_heading(b.get('text',''), b.get('runs') or [])))" → 0 flips out of 26 paragraph blocks. Then note that orangetrack_source.py:340 (headings_from_bold=False) is the only thing enforcing Decision 2b.
findings.assessment: Behaviour is CORRECT today; this is a missing regression guard, exactly the same class as the test audit's H-3 (the flag not gating orangetrack, which killed zero tests and was fixed in the wave-5 pass). tech-spec § Risks already records the same measurement ('0 of 49 orangetrack paragraph blocks in its 37 fixtures would flip'), so the state is known rather than newly discovered. Under the operator's 2026-08-06 rule the trigger is unmeasured, so this belongs in the report rather than in code — but it is the single strongest candidate for a follow-up test, because the thing it fails to protect is orangetrack's live output.

findings.assessment: Documentation staleness, not a coverage gap: the behaviour carries 20 tests repo-wide and 23 file-scoped. Nothing to fix in code or tests.

findings.title: AC4's only covering assertion lives in a test named for a different behaviour
findings.expected: A criterion has a test whose name states what it protects, so a refactor cannot delete the protection by accident.
findings.actual: The assertion that proves AC4 — a block with runs: [] plus a RU paragraph carrying **markers** yields a bold run — sits inside tests/test_llm_common.py::TestPatchTextDecodesBoldRuns::test_non_text_block_passes_through, whose stated subject is image blocks passing through untouched. test_ru_with_marker_splices_runs covers only the case where the source ALREADY had the run.
findings.reproduction: Read tests/test_llm_common.py:389-401. The AC4 evidence is the last three assertions; the test name mentions none of it.
findings.assessment: AC4 is met (and was already true in production since the 2026-07-28 fix; this feature does not regress it). The risk is only that a future rename or split of that test drops the assertion silently.

findings.title: An exception inside the shared walker skips the article for that tick instead of degrading to flat text
findings.expected: AC5's spirit — a markup failure degrades to plain text; the tick survives; the article is not lost.
findings.actual: Measured: with dom_blocks.BlockBuilder.walk patched to raise, t_hunted_source.fetch_t_hunted_article PROPAGATES the exception. It is caught by news_bot.fetch_full_article (news_bot.py:3646) which logs and returns None, so job() counts dropped_no_article and continues. The tick survives, and the link is not mark_processed'ed (that happens later, news_bot.py:4100), so the entry is retried on the next tick — but it does not publish as flat text. This became reachable when paragraphs started being DERIVED from blocks (t_hunted_source.py:255 onward), which is also what makes the two lists impossible to desync.
findings.reproduction: Patch dom_blocks.BlockBuilder.walk with side_effect=RuntimeError, call t_hunted_source.fetch_t_hunted_article with a mocked session over any corpus fixture → RuntimeError propagates. Without the patch the same call returns 2 paragraphs / 12 blocks.
findings.assessment: AC5's two NAMED triggers (site changed layout, broken HTML) are handled and tested — BeautifulSoup does not raise on either, and test_broken_markup_still_returns_flat_text proves flat text comes out. The uncovered case is a code defect inside dom_blocks, which is a DERIVED risk with zero occurrences across the 10 t-hunted and 24 orangetrack fixtures. Per the operator's 2026-08-06 rule this is recorded as an observation, not built into the code.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: US-AC1 — bold, subheadings and lists from the original are visible to the reader in the published Telegraph page (t-hunted)
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Offline the chain is proven only as far as the Telegraph node tree. Whether the reader sees the same structure as the original page is a visual judgement on a live publication, and the whole feature exists because the operator noticed the problem by reading the channel.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: The first t-hunted publication after the deploy.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Open the published Telegra.ph page and the source article side by side. Confirm: bold spans inside paragraphs are bold (not literal ** and not flattened); paragraphs that are subheadings in the original render as headings, not as bold paragraphs; lists render as list items with exactly ONE bullet each (a doubled '• •' means the bullet guard mis-fired). Do this for 3-5 fresh articles per the user-spec — t-hunted is the only source that can be re-fetched freely; lamley is throttled 20 s + 24 h blacklist and autoevolution returns 403.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: US-AC9 — the number of images on a gallery publication does not exceed the cap, for t-hunted AND orangetrack
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: The cap is enforced and tested inside the renderer, but the count on a real published page cannot be observed offline. orangetrack needs checking specifically because its output changed DELIBERATELY in this release — the golden diff shows gallery posts dropping from 20 rendered figures to 10.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: A gallery-format publication from t-hunted, and separately one from orangetrack, after the deploy.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Count

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: US-AC8 — no blocks/paragraphs mismatch WARNING on real articles
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: The tests prove the guard fires on a genuine mismatch and does not false-positive on the shapes covered by fixtures. Whether it stays quiet on the real feed can only be seen in production logs — and a guard that fires on every article would silently disable the whole feature while every positive test stayed green.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: At least one full publishing day after the deploy (slots 10:00 / 15:00 / 19:30 МСК).
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: ssh root@45.90.216.165 "docker logs hw-news-bot 2>&1 | grep -c '\[align\]'" — expect 0. If non-zero, capture the full lines: each names the article link and both counts (patchable_blocks=N paragraphs=M). Any hit means those articles published as plain text; report the link and the two numbers rather than just the count.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: Decorative lead «💬 …» present and the last paragraph not left in the source language
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: This is the direct read-out of what Task 7's aligned subtitle lift fixes — the 2026-05-06 shift incident, where a one-off desynchronisation published the tail paragraph in the source language. Offline all 10 corpus fixtures are aligned, but the corpus is 10 articles and the feed is not.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: The first t-hunted publication after the deploy.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: In the channel post, confirm the decorative lead «💬 «…»» is present and is the first paragraph of the article, and that it is not duplicated inside the body. Then read the LAST paragraph of the Telegra.ph page and confirm it is Russian, not Portuguese. A Portuguese tail paragraph is the shift incident and is grounds for setting SOURCE_FORMATTING_ENABLED=0 — noting that this takes effect only on restart, which is barred 10:00-20:00 МСК, so the log line above is the faster same-day signal.
